name: Elementaler
source:
Tiartri Shemir (nickname Tia) is a curious girl. Since childhood she longed for adventures. There is a rumor that lost royal property can be found on the top of a certain mountain. Tia takes a request to find out whether there is something there or not. But the adventure turns out to be much more difficult than expected...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
